name: v2-base
note: Regression anchor. The v4-verdict architecture (d192 4+4 ff768, 4.28M) rebuilt on model_v2's SDPA blocks, on the 16-feature v4.1 pack. Differs from runs/v41-asyn-h100 in exactly two ways: the encoder/decoder internals (custom blocks, parameter-identical) and the f14 pedal-feature exclusion. Anything this run loses against v41-asyn-h100's 771.6 ms render / 6.28 vel / 5.6 ms asyn is a port defect, not a result.

model._pos: sinusoidal, not rope: this config's job is to reproduce the v4 architecture. RoPE is implemented and tested; flipping it here is the next one-variable ablation, not part of the anchor.
model._activation: relu because nn.TransformerEncoderLayer defaults to relu and model.py never overrode it.
model._heads: true, not "auto": a v41 pack without note_labels must abort, not silently train the decoder alone (CLUSTER_QUEUE.md gates this by eye today).
model._exclude_features: f14 = pedal_state, which is also the fourth per-note head target. Leaving it in makes the pedal head copy its own input (LOG.md 2026-08-10 Vienna re-probe: the 0.3cc/1.17cc pedal MAEs are largely self-copy). Removed from the input projection entirely, not zeroed.

train._schedule: Identical to the v4 verdict runs (96 epochs, batch 48, 3e-4 cosine after 300 warmup steps) so this run is comparable to them without a caveat.
